mapper.select: SELECT id, name, amount, to_char(updated_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "updatedAt" FROM asset WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO asset (user_id, name, amount, updated_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{name}, #{amount}, now())
mapper.update: UPDATE asset SET name = #{name}, amount = #{amount}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM asset WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
